what: Tidy Tools for Inspecting and Comparing R Package Structure
title: Tidy Tools for Inspecting and Comparing R Package Structure
text: pkginspectr lets peek inside R packages. inspects local folders well packages downloaded GitHub CRAN returns tidy tibbles easy work . Key functions include: pkg_structure() – counts files, folders, R scripts, tests, docs data. pkg_lines() – counts lines code, comments, roxygen blank lines, R/ tests. pkg_summary() – one table. pkg_plot() (just plot()) – draws simple customisable bar charts results console. Counts designed trustworthy: lines classified R’s parser, files R CMD build ship counted (.Rbuildignore, .git/ friends skipped), local folder CRAN release package give comparable results.

title: Count lines of R code in packages — pkg_lines
text: path character vector packages. element one : local folder, "." "~/code/mypkg". Use "local::path" explicit. GitHub repository, "r-lib/cli" github.com URL. Add @ref branch, tag commit ("r-lib/cli@v3.6.0"). package subfolder, use github:: prefix: "github::owner/repo/subdir". CRAN package, "desc". Add @version older release ("cran::desc@1.4.0"). Archived packages supported. Without prefix, existing local folders take precedence, "owner/repo" treated GitHub bare name CRAN. path exist (e.g. "./mypkg") error, GitHub request. include_ignored TRUE, also analyse files matched package's .Rbuildignore. Version-control folders R's built-build exclusions always skipped. quiet TRUE, suppress progress messages. cache keep downloaded GitHub CRAN packages: "session" (default): temporary folder, removed R closes. "persistent": user cache folder kept across R sessions. fixed versions stored : CRAN releases GitHub refs look like commit SHA version tag ("owner/repo@v1.2.0"). Requests can change time (ref, branch) always fetch latest code use session cache instead. "none": always download afresh. Use pkg_cache_clear() empty cache.

title: Count lines of R code in packages — pkg_lines
text: pkginspectr_tbl one row per package columns: package, version total_lines: lines analysed files. type (four add total_lines): code_lines: lines containing code, including code followed comment lines inside multi-line strings. comment_lines: lines containing regular (#) comment. roxygen_lines: lines containing roxygen (#') comment. blank_lines: empty whitespace-lines. location (three add total_lines): r_lines: lines R/. test_lines: lines tests/. other_lines: lines elsewhere (e.g. data-raw/). : function_lines: code lines inside function definitions (subset code_lines). Nested functions counted .

title: Count lines of R code in packages — pkg_lines
text: Lines classified R's parser (utils::getParseData()), strings contain # unbalanced braces counted correctly, functions detected however written (<-, =, \(x) lambdas, anonymous functions inside calls). Files fail parse fall back line-based heuristic function lines counted; warning names file. files R CMD build ship analysed, results local folder comparable results CRAN tarball. particular, anything listed .Rbuildignore (often data-raw/) skipped unless include_ignored = TRUE.

title: pkginspectr 0.2.0
text: pkg_lines() returns non-overlapping columns. code_lines, comment_lines, roxygen_lines blank_lines add total_lines, r_lines, test_lines other_lines. function_lines now counts code lines inside functions. deprecated get_code_stats() keeps original columns. pkg_structure(): num_r_files, num_function_r_files num_non_function_r_files now count scripts R/ (previously test data-raw/ scripts included). Lines now classified R’s parser (utils::getParseData()) instead regular expressions brace counting. Functions assigned =, \(x) lambdas anonymous functions counted; one-line functions longer absorb following line; {, } # inside strings longer miscounted. Files fail parse produce warning. files R CMD build ship counted: .Rbuildignore, version-control folders R’s built-exclusions respected, local folders CRAN tarballs comparable. Use new include_ignored = TRUE argument count .Rbuildignored files . Lower-case .r files, .Rnw vignettes .rds/.csv/.tsv/.tab/.txt data files now recognised.

title: pkginspectr 0.2.0
text: Clearer package sources path: Explicit prefixes local::, github:: cran::. Unprefixed input still works, path exist (e.g. "./mypkg") now error instead GitHub request. GitHub refs ("r-lib/cli@v3.6.0"), subfolders ("github::owner/repo/subdir") browser URLs (github.com/owner/repo/tree/<ref>/<subdir>). Older CRAN releases ("cran::desc@1.4.0") archived CRAN packages. New cache argument ("session", "persistent" "none"). persistent cache keeps fixed versions (CRAN releases, GitHub commit SHAs version tags) across R sessions; GitHub branches always fetched fresh. pkg_summary() returns pkg_structure() pkg_lines() one table, resolving downloading package . plot() works pkginspectr result. pkg_plot() documents styling arguments (text_col, bar_col, bg_col, glyph, start, end, max_bars, title), views accept set. Metric bars scaled metric’s largest value, packages easy compare. package view groups metrics “Files” (shares num_files) “Lines” (shares total_lines), shows num_dirs without misleading percentage. Default titles describe data. pkg_structure(), pkg_lines() pkg_summary() gain quiet = TRUE suppress progress messages. New pkginspectr_example() returns path small example package bundled pkginspectr, examples run offline. New “Get started” vignette: vignette("pkginspectr").

title: pkginspectr 0.2.0
text: GitHub downloads longer use GitHub API, longer limited 60 requests per hour. CRAN downloads work CRAN mirror set (e.g. Rscript), longer miss packages need newer R version. Cached downloads keyed owner, repository ref, -named repos different owners longer collide, failed download longer leaves broken cache entry behind. Files classified path relative package root. Previously package stored folder named tests/, man/ data/ files misclassified. pkg_cache_clear() returns cleared path (NULL) invisibly, documented, message longer lists cache types called without arguments. GitHub CRAN lookups longer fail suggested glue package installed; glue longer used.

title: pkginspectr 0.2.0
text: pkginspectr now requires R >= 4.1.0 purrr >= 1.0.0, longer depends tidyr httr. Examples longer use \dontrun{} longer clear persistent cache. Added GitHub Actions workflows R CMD check test coverage.

title: pkginspectr 0.1.0
text: Added inspect_package() returns key statistics R package. particular: package: package name version: version number num_files: number files package num_dirs: number directories package num_r_files: number R files package num_function_r_files: number R files containing functions num_non_function_r_files: number R files containing functions num_test_files: number test files package num_vignettes: number vignettes package num_docs: number documentation files package num_data_files: number data files package Added get_code_stats() returns code statistics R package. particular: package: package name version: version number total_lines: total number lines code blank_lines: total number blank lines comment_lines: total number comment lines roxygen_lines: total number roxygen lines function_lines: total number lines within functions test_lines: total number lines within test files Added plot_pkg() plots output inspect_package() get_code_stats() console. Users can modify colours shapes plot make uniquely . offers two modes type = "package" type = "metric": type = "package" plots package statistics multiple packages grouped package name. type = "metric" plots package statistics grouped metric. pkginspectr retrieves package information local packages CRAN, GitHub repositories. Updated README.md examples use package. Added tests functions using testthat. Create informative README.md.
